title: Brusquembille
subtitle: Italian classic trick-taking — 40-card deck, no must-follow

hint.lead_trump: Lead a trump to seize the initiative
hint.lead_low: Lead a low card to keep your point cards
hint.lead_value: Play a high-value card to score
hint.follow_cut: Cut the trick with a trump
hint.follow_win: Win with a stronger card of the same suit
hint.follow_dump: You can't win — dump a low card

message.yourTurn: Your turn — any card is playable (no must-follow)
message.trickComplete: Trick complete — advance to the next

tutorial.trump: The card laid sideways under the stock is the trump (brusquembille). Its suit beats every other suit.
tutorial.trick: Cards played to the table. Win with a higher card of the same suit, or any trump (no must-follow).
tutorial.hand: Your hand — click a card to play it. Brusquembille scores differently: A = 11, 3 = 10.
tutorial.score: Tricks, stock left, and points. The deck totals 120 points; reach 61 to win.
